dedupe_keys.name: ashrae occupant behaviour data cleaning scripts

description: The ASHRAE occupant-behaviour database contributors publish Python scripts for cleaning the raw studies used in their global database. The repository groups study-specific transformations by processing phase and includes notebooks, plotting checks and a column-heading export example. Its README links the raw and cleaned data and contribution templates. Source access is public and free under MIT. Coverage follows the heterogeneous building studies represented by data-ashrae-global-occupant-behavior-database. Cleaned observations and metadata can help prepare occupancy schedules for agent-based building simulations and model-energyplus comparisons. A caveat is that these are study-specific scripts with local paths and manual column conventions, not a uniform package for arbitrary sensor data. Sampling and missing-value rules require review for each study. Example source was inspected, but no cleaning or schema workflow was executed.
